subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: -at words (cat, mat, fat, sat); Week 6: -an words (pan, fan, can, van); segment, blend and write the words

show.line: Words in the at family! Cat, mat, fat, sat. They all end with at.

rounds.prompt: Listen. m, a, t. What word is it?
Which word is in the at family?
Break it up! Say the sounds in cat.
Is it in the at family? Sort the words.

hints: Look at the end. Does it say at?
Change the first sound. c-at, m-at, s-at.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says fat. f, a, t.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. f, a, t. Fat!

parent_line: Can read and build words in the at family: cat, mat, fat, sat.
